remarks: Built in 2023! Excellent opportunity to own a newer-construction two-family home in the City of Buffalo. This thoughtfully designed duplex features two completely separate units. The upper unit offers 2 bedrooms, 1.5 baths and a covered front porch, while the lower unit features 1 bedroom, 1 full bath and its own covered rear porch. Each residence has its own washer and dryer, completely separate utilities and dedicated living space, providing convenience and privacy for both occupants. Off-street parking is located at the rear of the property. The property also features central air conditioning, gas forced-air heat and a low-maintenance exterior. Conveniently located on Lafayette Avenue with easy access to shopping, dining, entertainment and Downtown Buffalo. An excellent opportunity for an owner-occupant looking to offset housing costs with rental income or an investor seeking a newer multifamily property with modern systems and limited near-term capital improvement needs. Rare opportunity to own a recently constructed duplex in an established Buffalo neighborhood.
